title: Skip sccache install in setup --ci to speed up CI
summary: Setup step 4 builds sccache from source even under `--ci`, and CI never uses it. Skip the sccache install when `--ci` is set, test that, and note it in the docs and changelog.

defaults_applied.how: Only skip sccache under --ci; no workflow changes.
Add a unit test for the skip decision in xtask.
Located the cause in xtask setup step 4 and the CI workflow rather than asking.
Changelog and docs note explains why --ci skips sccache.

assumptions: The slowdown is only the sccache `cargo install` in setup step 4, run by `./setup.sh --ci` in both CI jobs; CI sets no RUSTC_WRAPPER.
The fix is to skip sccache install when --ci is passed, not to remove the pin or add CI caching.
Other CI speedups (rust-cache, merging jobs) are not requested.

acceptance_criteria.text: In xtask/src/main.rs, `setup --ci` no longer calls install_sccache; the sccache step prints a skip message when flags.ci is set, and non-CI setup still installs the pinned sccache.
The skip decision is a small pure function or a flag check covered by a unit test in xtask (ci skips, non-ci does not).
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the change, and README.md/docs/decisions.md state that --ci skips sccache (README line about sccache setup is corrected).
Run `cargo test -p xtask` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`: all pass.
athena.toml, .github/workflows/ci.yml and the [tools.sccache] pin are unchanged, so the change and study capabilities keep using sccache.

out_of_scope: Changing the sccache pin or its use by change/study capabilities
Adding CI dependency caching or restructuring workflow jobs
departures: Small, well-located change; slightly lower cost than the reference.
